Q5253.reason: The interest an owner keeps after conveying a lesser estate is a reversion, which stays with the transferor and arises automatically by operation of law without any special words.

Q5347.reason: The first energy a maximal 1–2 second contraction can use is ATP already stored in the muscle, which is directly usable before any regeneration pathway starts.

Q8413.reason: The Grand Chamber treated state immunity as a legitimate, proportionate limit on Article 6 access to court, so the immunity rule and the fair-trial right were compatible and there was no breach.
